chapter.verse: Kong itte aw, kha khempeuh um kei unla, Pasian' kiangpan ahih ahihloh na theih nadingun khate sittel un. A hang pen kamsang zuaute tampi leitung zuanin paikhia khinta hi.
Pasian' Kha Siangtho hih bangin na theician uh hi: Jesu Khris cilesa mihing hong suak khinzo hi, ci-in a pulak kha khempeuh Pasian' kiangpan ahi hi.
Jesu a pulak lo kha khempeuh ahihleh Pasian' kiangpan hilo uh hi. Tua pen hong pai ding ci-a na zak uh, tu-in zong leitung ah a om khin ahi Khris-langneihmi ii kha ahi hi.
Tanote aw, note pen Pasian' kiangpan na hi uh a, kamsang zuaute zong a zo khinzo na hi uh hi. Banghanghiam cihleh note' sunga ompa pen leitunga ompa sangin lianzaw hi.
Amau pen leitung pan ahih manun leitung dinmun pan thu gen uh a, leitung in zong amau' thugen ngai uh hi.

Eite i hihleh Pasian' kiangpan i hi hi. Pasian a theite khempeuh in i thugen hong ngai uh a, Pasian' kiangpan ahilo khempeuh in i thugen hong ngai lo uh hi. Hih tungtawnin thumaan thutak Kha leh khialhna kha i theician hi.
Kong itte aw, itna pen Pasian' kiangpan ahih manin eite khatlekhat ki-it ni. A hang pen mi a it peuhpeuh Pasian' kiangpan hi a, Pasian zong a thei ahi hi.
Pasian pen itna ahih manin mi a it lo peuhpeuh Pasian a thei lo ahi hi.
Eite' lakah Pasian' itna hih bangin hong kilang hi: Pasian in khat bek ahi ama' Tapa leitung ah hong sawl hi. Tua tapa' tungtawnin eite i nuntak theih nading ahi hi.
Itna i cih ciangin eite in Pasian it cihna hilo-in amah in ei hong itin eite' mawhphelna ahi dingin ama' Tapa hong sawl cih thu hi.
Kong itte aw, Pasian in tua zahin hong it ahihleh eite zong khatlekhat i ki-it ding kilawm hi.
Kuamah in Pasian mu ngeilo hi. Eite khatlekhat i ki-it leh eite' sungah Pasian omkipin i sungah ama' itna hong cingtaak hi.
Eite' tungah ama' kha hong pia khinzo ahih manin ama' sungah eite omkipin ei' sungah amah omkip ahihlam tu-a bangin i theician hi.
Pa in leitung Honkhiapa ahi dingin a Tapa hong sawlkhia khinzo a, tua pen kote in mu khinin teci ka pang khin uh hi.
Jesu pen Pasian' Tapa hi ci-in a pulak peuhpeuh pen ama' sungah Pasian a omkip hi a, amah zong Pasian' sungah omkip hi.
Tua hi a, eite' tunga Pasian' hong neih itna, i thei i um hi. Pasian pen itna hi; itna sungah a omkip peuhpeuh Pasian' sungah a omkip hi a, ama' sungah zong Pasian omkip hi.
Khris mah bangin eite zong hih leitung ah om i hih manin thukhenna ni ciangin sunglam kimuanna i neih theih nadingin tu-a bangin eite' sungah itna hong cingtaak hi.
Itna sungah launa om lo a, itna cingtaak in launa hemkhia hizaw hi. A hang pen launa pen gawtna tawh kipaikan hi a, a lau peuhpeuh itna sungah a cingtaak nailo ahi hi.
Pasian in eite hong it masak manin eite in i it hi.
Mi khatpeuh in, “Pasian ka it hi,” ci henla a sanggampa a muhdah leh amah zuauphuak ahi hi. A hang pen a muh theih a sanggampa a itlo mi in a muh theihloh Pasian it theilo ding hi.
Tua hi a, ama' kiangpan hih thupiakna i ngah hi: Pasian a it peuhpeuh in a sanggamte zong a it kul hi.
